text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's Midal Cables company, which clinched a deal with Jordan last week worth $5 million for 400-kilovolt cables, to deliver the order before the end of the year.
- Teenage Bahraini designers appeal for eight million dinars backing to build a giant water theme park.
- Gulf Arab states to discuss ways of unifying minimum wages for employees in the private sector.
